thread:
evan: FYI — ACME (acct: acct_4452) escalated to privacy. They submitted a GDPR deletion request and are asking: full data deletion (inputs + model caches + logs), proof (audit log), which sub-processors handle their data, and whether we support KMS/HSM for Hosted. They also want EU residency (eu-west-1). Can we get an ETA and exact steps we’ll take?

maria: @evan thanks. Do we have the original request email/ticket? Hosted vs Dedicated matters here — Hosted has different guarantees. Quick answers: we can delete customer data on request, provide audit export. Hosted uses provider-managed CMKs; BYOK/HSM is only available on Dedicated/Private. I’ll confirm retention windows and sub-processor snapshot.

ev an: shared the ticket link in DM and pasted the customer message excerpt: "Please delete all conversation history, logs, and any cached model state for org acct_4452. We require written confirmation and an audit of the deletion steps. Also confirm which third parties process our data."

suresh: infra note: for Hosted (default): data at rest is encrypted with Redwood-managed KMS keys (cloud provider CMKs). We cannot export keys from HSM for Hosted. For Dedicated/Private we support customer-managed KMS and HSM integrations (BYOK). For deletion, process is: 1) enqueue deletion job, 2) purge internal DB rows and object store keys, 3) invalidate KV/model caches, 4) mark logs as deleted and trigger async compaction, 5) generate audit record. Typical wall time for a single org on Hosted: ~1-3 hours depending on retention bucket size.

leah: legal: DPA already signed? If yes, reference the DPA section on deletion timelines. We maintain an official sub-processor list (upd weekly) — send customer the snapshot. For proof: we can provide a signed deletion confirmation + audit export (job id + timestamps + affected resources). If the customer requires geo-residency guarantees going forward, advise Dedicated/Private.

incidents-bot: Created support ticket: SUP-2024-1123 (linked to thread). Assigned to evan.

evan: customer confirmed DPA signed last month. They pressed on "which sub-processors" and asked for a CSV of current list + date snapshot. Also asked whether model weights or embeddings persist anywhere after deletion.

maria: embeddings are stored like other data: object store + DB indexes. Deletion job removes both and triggers cache invalidation. We do not retain customer inputs in long-term eval datasets unless opt-in; our policy is documented in the DPA. I’ll grab the current sub-processor CSV and DPA reference link: https://redwood.infra/legal/dpa (send to customer).

suresh: repro / admin steps I’ll run once we have customer confirmation of timeframe: ```
# admin flow (internal)
POST /internal/v1/customers/{acct}/deletion-jobs  { type: "full" }
# backend kicks off purge
grpc -> purge-db acct_{id}
invalidate-kv --org acct_{id}
monitor job SUP-2024-1123
# on completion export audit: /internal/v1/audit/exports/{job_id}
``` Estimated: job start -> completion ~ 30-180m; audit export generation ~ 5-20m. Will attach the audit JSON and a signed confirmation PDF.

leah: please include the DPA clause reference and the sub-processor CSV snapshot in the confirmation. Also capture the customer IP/caller email in the ticket for compliance. Once deletion complete, we need to retain an internal record of the deletion event (job id, who authorized) for our compliance log per retention rules.

evan: I’ll reply to the customer with timeline (we need their acknowledgement of ~2 hours downtime window) and ask if they want the sub-processor CSV before or after deletion. I’ll cc legal. Starting the job only after explicit go-ahead from the customer.

maria: sounds good. When you have the go-ahead, post here and tag @suresh so infra can start immediately. I’ll prepare the sub-processor CSV and DPA snippet now.

suresh: one heads-up — if customer insists on EU-only residency for backups + logs moving forward, we’ll propose Dedicated in eu-west-1; migration estimate is multi-week. For deletion only, Hosted purge path above is fine.

evan: noted. I’ll send the proposed text to the customer and ask for immediate confirmation. Will update thread once they sign off. :thumbsup:
